title: Redesigning Our Onboarding: A Case Study
excerpt: We cut time-to-first-value from 12 minutes to 3 by removing steps, not adding tooltips.
content:
Our onboarding had 9 steps and a 40% completion rate. The fix wasn't more explanation — it was removing 5 of the 9 steps entirely and deferring them to first real use.

Time-to-first-value went from 12 minutes to under 3.

title: Why I Stopped Designing in High Fidelity First
excerpt: Polished mockups get less honest feedback — people critique the color, not the flow.
content:
I used to jump straight to high-fidelity mockups. The feedback I got was almost always about color and spacing, never the actual flow — because a polished screen looks "done," and people don't want to argue with done.

Grayscale wireframes get much more honest structural feedback.
